name: – Tomáš Kubín – Commission proposal to the Council
title: REPORT on the proposal for a Council directive on the structure and rates of excise duty applied to tobacco and tobacco related products (recast)
part_text:
The report sets out Parliament's position on new European Union rules for taxing tobacco and nicotine products. It asks for lower minimum tax rates than the Commission proposed, longer transition periods for Member States, and separate treatment for cigars and cigarillos. It also wants taxes on e-cigarette liquids whether or not they contain nicotine, and asks the Commission to check the impact on small cigar makers. Parliament's amendments are not final; the Council decides.

- Minimum taxes on cigarettes, cigars, roll-your-own tobacco, heated tobacco and nicotine pouches would be lower than proposed.
- Member States would get more time, up to 2033, to reach the new minimum rates.
- The Council must now decide whether to accept Parliament's changes or amend the proposal.
